$comment: Languages the text signals cover; single source of truth for both runtimes. Detection first classifies the script of the letters in a text (kana -> ja, Hangul -> ko, Han -> zh, Arabic -> ar, Cyrillic and Latin -> stopword vote among the languages of that script). The order of entries within a script is the tie order of the vote and its first entry is the default when no stopword matches. matchMode 'word' = space tokens and word-boundary phrase matching; 'substring' = plain substring matching for languages written without spaces.
